# Lionheart Fixt 0.10.3 - repairs

The Templar initiation no longer dies with Sir Esteban: if he is killed before you finish his
tasks, Lord Javier says the line the game wrote for it and sends you on to Auric. And both
Auric and Javier now remember you attacking them -- the voiced rebuke plays when you come
back from the cell, and the cathedral posts the extra guard its map built for the occasion.

**Fixt** is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. Esteban's fix works on any save; the other two need a
character who hasn't entered the armory or the cathedral.
